name: Tony Rigatoni's Pasta Passion
author: Addicting Games
description: Tony Rigatoni's Pasta Passion is a drawing puzzle game. In it, Mr. Tony Rigatoni is patiently waiting for a scrumptious plate of pasta! Your job is to drag a spaghetti noodle past other customers and the wait staff into Tony’s mouth. Along the way, there are meatballs for you to collect by drawing your noodle through them to add more flavor to Tony's meal. Be careful though, because if you draw the noodle too fast, you'll break it!
